notes.title: v1.4.3 with Replay Handling
notes.notes: Added replay handling for starting, stopping, and saving the replay buffer in both OBS and Streamlabs OBS. Have a look and if there's any issues let us know!

notes.title: v1.4.2 with Small Possible Crash Fix
notes.notes: Only a fix for a possible case of crashing in edit mode

notes.title: v1.5.0 in Beta Channel
notes.notes:
We're pushing a new version into the Beta channel now. It has a couple of new test things.

[b]NOTE! This version may have crashes![/b]

You can switch to the beta channel from Properties, Betas on Steam. There's no beta key, just select the beta version and close.

You can switch away from beta version if you have issues with it, just opt out of betas in the same place.

So what's new? There's a couple of things.

[h3]UI Simplification[/h3]
Tired of looking at so many options when you just want to set the audio file to play? Now in Multifunctions there's no image/color/etc settings. They don't matter. And soon we will also declutter the Button actions a bit more. Let's put the more important stuff to the top instead of the bottom.

[h3]Reactions[/h3]
If you click Edit, Reactions you get to a new screen where you can add Reactions. The idea is that these are not things you'd have as buttons but rather as reactions to chat, hotkeys, MIDI, bits, channel points... all kinds of things. So just add a Reaction, set when it fires, and what it does (like a Multifunction).

Currently we only support Chat commands and MIDI commands, but during the beta we will push the other stuff out too.

[h3]MIDI[/h3]
As mentioned above, we now support MIDI, for buttons/keys. So far only in Reactions, but also coming to Buttons.

The app will automatically connect to all MIDI input devices available and will allow you to press a button/key on your device to bind to a Reaction. Later on we will add slider/knob support etc. Stay tuned!

There's other things in the pipeline too and some you can read between the lines. Stay tuned and happy betaing!

notes.title: v1.4.0 More Chat Options and v1.4.1 Totes Random
notes.notes:
Forgot to mention v1.4.0 so let's do that first! It brings more settings for Twitch Chat options. Now it's not just for mods that can use chat commands, you can choose which groups can! You can let everyone, subs, mods, turbo users to write things to chat and have Stream Control do things!

This is just a small first step for more actions available, stay tuned for additional things in v1.5.0 later this year (hopefully).

Then to v1.4.1, wihch is totes random. We added two options: Play Random Audio (in General) which plays a random audio file from a selected folder, and Random Media which allows setting a random file from a folder to a Media source in OBS/SLOBS.

These should've been there long time ago since we already have Random Image, but they were overlooked. Now they're there!

notes.title: v1.3.8 with Fixes to Groups
notes.notes:
Due to the way OBS Studio implemented Groups (they're scenes within scenes) it's a bit difficult to handle items inside them properly. This version addresses some issues and should make toggling work better with them.

So if you had trouble toggling visibility of your funny GIFs inside a group, take this one for a spin!

notes.title: v1.3.7 with Fixes and Previous Stuff
notes.notes:
v1.3.7 fixes an issue with some users and hotkeys not registering correctly on startup. They should now all be handled properly.

Also previoysly not reported new things:

[list]
[*] Filter enable/disable. Add funny filter to your voice? Turn it on or off with the push of a button! Same with video filters
[*] Version check so that OBS Studio and OBS WebSocket aren't too old. If they are too old there will be issues with compatibility
[*] Support for newer version of mobile app which loads images to buttons differently. This should make for a bit snappier interface
[*] Fix deselecting hotkey for an action

[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.4 with Studio Mode
notes.notes:
For some reason the Studio Mode controls have been missing. Now they've been added to Scenes section of the software. You can turn Studio Mode on or off and transition between the scenes. Setting the scene to transition to can be set with the usual [i]Scene Change[/i] button.

Happy studioing!

notes.title: v1.3.3 with Streamlabs OBS fix
notes.notes:
Streamlabs changed the way their OBS works so this fixes those things. Now connecting to SLOBS works again.

[b]Note![/b] You have to go to Settings - Remote control and click on the QR code before clicking Connect on Stream Control. SLOBS apparently added a security feature so you can't just connect without doing this first.

We will still continue to test that nothing else was broken in their updates and might push more updates if things are found.

notes.title: v1.2.1 - Copypasteimportexport
notes.notes:
We added copy/paste and import/export to Multifunctions also due to report of them being impossible to use there. This should help in creating better Multifunctions easily. We also added dragging items into Multifunctions like it existed before.

Once again, thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: v1.2.0 - New UIs and Chat Commands!
notes.notes:
First new thing here: new Multifunction interface! Now when editing a Multifunction you'll be greeted with a tree instead of a grid. This makes it more intuitive to see what is going on and how the actions run.

Note: Old Multifunctions may show empty actions and Up Folder actions, you can delete these with right mouse click. Next version hopefully does this automatically.

Second new thing: Chat Commands! You can now set a Twitch chat command that will run an action on Stream Control! The commands work for the streamer and mods at the moment, better control will be added later.

Forgot to change from BRB screen to game screen? Mods trying to shout at you in chat but too into an action scene in game? No problem! Mods can just type !gameview (or whatever you choose) and Stream Control will change to the correct view and stream is saved!

You can set the chat commands to each action in the settings. The command must be exact. If the command is "!gameview" then saying "!gameview you silly streamer" will not run it.

notes.title: v1.1.4 - I Remember!
notes.notes:
We added a feature that the app rememberes location on screen. No more moving it around all the time for those who want it in a specific place.

Thanks for the feature suggestion!

notes.title: v1.1.3 Released with bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.3 is now out with a couple of bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Control key works properly in keypresses
[*] Alt key works properly in keypresses
[*] A capital letter in hold keys may cause hang
[*] Multimedia button "previous" sent "play/pause" instead
[/list]

Also added a feature of sending AltGr in keypresses with # modifier instead of the % for left alt.

There's still a few things in need of checking in the key handling but this should fix the problems reported to us. Once again, thank you very much for the reports!

notes.title: v1.1.1 and Future
notes.notes:
We've published v1.1.1 with a couple of changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed key press command, it only accepted the {home} etc written in lowercase
[*] Added Streamlabs Roll Credits functionality
[*] Changed the UI style slightly
[/list]

Thanks for the comments and reports!

Also about the future. Since we have a strong feature set working we're going to focus on a couple of usability things next. The programmability features aren't the best since they are just the same grid and it's not obvious how they work. We wanted to have a nice tree structure to make it clear from the start but it was faster to get the product out this way. So next we will make the programmable functions look proper so it's clear what is happening when you press a button.

If you have any comments, feedback, bugs, anything, just send a message or join the [url=https://discord.gg/95bKXuK]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: v1.1.0 with fix for program launching
notes.notes:
v1.1.0 pushed out

Fixes an issue with some programs not launching (like OBS Studio) since the working directory was not set to their liking. Now they will be hapy. Thanks for the report!

Also added an indicator for Twitch chat connection. Later will change some other iconography also in the application.

More to come, keep the suggestions and reports coming :)

notes.title: v1.0.20 with Performance Enhancing Substances
notes.notes:
We did say there were performance enhancements in the mobile apps, but we needed to do a bit more. Now the apps work even nicer after we get this update out.

It will be in two parts: this PC app first so you can get it running, then come the mobile apps. This due to the new mobile app not working fully with the old PC app so we need to wait for the updates.

Also we fixed the Pause and Keypress "wait for pressing again" things. Now in Pause zero means "wait until I press again" and in Keypress zero is "don't wait" and one is "wait until I press again." This is due to not being able to input -1 into the selection as we previously told you to do. Stupid us.

Twitch Create Clip button now gives a nicer error message if not logged in properly or stream not running.

Also some UI changes, the selection list is on the right so the buttons don't move away when opening edit mode. And animation. Animations are always nice, I guess.

notes.title: v1.0.19 with Clips
notes.notes:
A small update with a new Twitch button: Create Clip. This should've been added a long time ago but somehow got lost in the work. If it shows an error 404 it means no stream is running. 401 means you need to re-authorize Twitch from the Settings cog top right.

We will add an UI to see all the clips you've created so you can go and edit them and view them and post them on chat and whatnot. Just wanted to get this out there quickly.

notes.title: v1.0.18 with Keypress time
notes.notes:
New version with a small addition to Keypress: you can now set it to press the keys selected and hold them pressed for a preselected time. You can also set the time to -1 and it'll wait for you to press the button again and then it'll release the buttons.

Another user request done, what will we do next...

notes.title: v1.0.17 with new Keypress for better compatibility
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.17 changes the way we handle the Keypress functionality. We got a report that it doesn't work with all games so we tweaked it and now it seems to work better. Do give it a try and let us know if there's any issues!

We also added a bit more error reporting for possible typos in the {key} markings etc so that should help with possible error situations.

Thanks once again for the reports and keep them coming!

notes.title: v1.0.16 with Stability Enhancements
notes.notes:
We've again fixed a couple of cases with issues in the application so it should be even more stable than before.

Also we'd like to mention that the reason we don't catch all possible issues in the app is so that we can get reports from the actual issues when the application is used. This helps use to fix the problems immediately rather than have a general band-aid on things and assume things work.

Thanks for the reports and keep the suggestions coming!

notes.title: v1.0.15 with a couple of fixes
notes.notes:
Released 1.0.15 with a mitigation for a random crash and also a fix for the web view that was reported.

Thanks for all the comments and messages, keep them coming!

notes.title: Discord open for easier comments and questions
notes.notes: Since it's all the rage these days there's now also a Discord server for any questions and suggestions you might have. Just hop into [url=https://discord.gg/95bKXuK]our Discord[/url].

notes.title: v1.0.14 Enhancements and Pause Cancel
notes.notes:
We've enhanced a few things like communication with the mobile part. We still would like it to be a bit more snappy and we're working on it. It's mostly on older devices, but we want to have everything working fine on all devices.

There's one new change: Pause can be canceled without canceling the whole Multifunction!

This is usable for example in situations where you want to switch to another scene temporarily, or move items etc. So you can make a Multifunction, add a Scene change, add a Pause with a very long duration, then a Scene change back. Now if you run this, it'll stay yellow until Pause ends or you can tap it again and the Pause will cancel but everything else will run after it.

You can tap again to cancel them also if needed.

notes.title: Breaking Change in v1.0.13!
notes.notes:
We've released v1.0.13 and it requires a new version of the mobile applications to work. The new mobile apps were pushed out yesterday so hopefully you've updated it already.

The new thing in this version is resizable grids. We know many people have are using a tablet size device and would like more actions on one screen and now it's possible.

Right click on the grid in edit mode and there's a new option for resizing. Do note that you can't shrink the grid if any of the buttons would be deleted. You'll have to manually delete them if you want a smaller grid than what you have and the buttons are on the outer edges.

We also fixed an issue with Reset in edit mode not updating the mobile clients properly.

Hope this makes the app even more useful for everyone and as always, feedback is welcome!

notes.title: v1.0.12 with Streamlabs events/jar/wheel support
notes.notes: We've added support for some Streamlabs features, like wheel, event pause/mute, and clearing jar. If there's any issues with these please let us know. You'll need to log in to Streamlabs from the settings cog and after that you can use the new actions.

notes.title: v1.0.11 and Usability
notes.notes:
We really like usable applications and very much know that there are some issues with our own products. Therefore we spent some time working on things and making one big pain point a lot smaller: connecting the mobile application to the PC.

Previously you needed to know the IP address to connect but now we've added a discovery option. When you start the mobile app it'll automatically search for Stream Control running on PCs on the same network and you can just select the one you want and tap connect. So much better!

The PC app is already up and the mobile apps will update in a moment when the app stores handle the submissions.

We will focus on other areas of usability also as always, the added tooltips hopefully were already useful and informative, and we will add other things to help out also. All feedback is appreciated, as always!

notes.title: v1.0.10 with a crash fix
notes.notes:
Pushed out a fix for two random crashes, one in canceling a Pause and another in just editing buttons.

New features coming out later!

notes.title: v1.0.9 with User Interface Enhancements, Counters, Backup etc
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.9[/h1]

We're pushing out a hot new version with some nice changes:

[list]
[*] Counters have an UI to add and edit them. No more random names in settings, only existing counters can be used
[*] Button settings have tooltips! Hover on the setting and you'll get information on what it does
[*] You can back up and restore your decks in Settings, also useful for copying to another machine
[*] You can export a button, including folders and multifunctions, and import them to another place, machine, wherever via context menu
[*] You can select a button and embed it in a folder if you're running out of space via context menu
[*] Settings are saved automatically leaving edit mode, no need for separate button press
[*] You can revert changes to buttons before exiting edit mode if things went wrong
[/list]

So do back up your settings from time to time to make sure you don't accidentally break anything while playing around, or if you want to copy them to another machine.

And with the export/import function you can even share your actions with friends! Made a cool multifunction and want them to have it? Just export and give it to them!

[h1]Older updates[/h1]

Seems we haven't explained changes in previous versions, so let's recap:

[list]
[*] Elgato Stream Deck alpha support. Enable in settings, doesn't work with confirmation requests and you must not have any other app using it at the same time
[*] Timer added, you can create a timer that ticks down on the screen, for example, a Be Right Back ticker
[*] Fixes for several Streamlabs OBS issues
[*] Color picker shows the colors you're using already for easy matching
[*] Fix for random image
[/list]

We hope this update makes Stream Control even nicer to use for everyone. Let us know!

notes.title: v1.0.4 with Streamlabs OBS fixes
notes.notes:
Seems the publishing to Steam broke Streamlabs OBS support somehow. We've now changed things around and this version should address this problem. So SLOBS connection should work just fine now. Sorry for not testing the Steam version thoroughly, we didn't expect it to be different from the version we test on development.

If there are still issues, just send us a note and we'll check it out!

notes.title: 1.0.3 out with Twitch chats!
notes.notes:
We pushed 1.0.2 and also 1.0.3 out now. Added support for Twitch chat commands so now you can send messages from your pad. Also the most used commands are there as shortcuts for convenience. This is, once again, in testing so there may be issues. Please report any problems to us.

Also noticed a silly bug: if you weren't connected to OBS Studio or Streamlabs OBS the mobile app didn't update your changes in realtime! That was bad of us to not notice it before. It's fixed.

We are also waiting for Streamlabs to check if they allow us to link to their systems. We have already implemented empty jar, spin wheel etc functionality but cannot provide it to you without their approval.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We pushed version 1.0.1 out. It has added hotkey support!

We got a request to add a hotkey support to the application since some users do have keyboard in front of them but they still wanted to use the app and its advanced features, so now it's possible!

Every item has a hotkey selection so you can just set it up and launch whatever features you want with it. Just make sure you don't put multiple buttons with the same hotkey. It's not supported and there's no error about it at the moment.

notes.title: Streamlabs OBS
notes.notes:
We've gotten questions about Streamlabs OBS support and how this application compares to the free Streamlabs Remote Control. I'm happy to announce that we have implemented support for Streamlabs OBS and a version having this built-in is on its way out, as soon as we test it a bit more. It is still beta functionality so there may be issues, but it is there.

Do note that Streamlabs OBS doesn't support some features that OBS Studio has, so not all functionality is equal. Mostly it is the same and for your convenience the same buttons work for both OBS Studio and Streamlabs OBS, unlike with Elgato Stream Deck.

As for comparison to Streamlabs Remote Control, we can say that you get what you pay for. It's a convenient tool if all you need is to mute/unmute, switch scenes and hide/show items on screen. If you don't need macros, editable button order, volume control, fades, animations, connections to other services etc it might be ok for you. It's free so you can just try it out. But in the end, if you want something that provides good value for your streaming experience and doesn't make you hunt for the button you want to press, you know what to get for yourself.

Note that at the moment some features, like filling the Source lists is not working but it will be added soon.

notes.title: Open For Business, What's Next?
notes.notes:
We are now open for business! Tokavuh Stream Control is available for purchase and you can grab it for yourself for immediate use. We are not sitting idly waiting for your patronage but are actively working on the product.

Some things we have planned for the near future:

[list]
[*]Better manual
[*]Videos on how to do specific things
[*]User interface enhancements
[*]iOS app to the store
[*]Android app enhancements
[*]Get Streamlabs OBS support to alpha stage
[*]Backing up settings
[*]Import/export for settings
[/list]

There are also many actual new features waiting to be implemented, but we want to focus on getting the main system running well, documentation up to par so it's easy to set up and use, and everything going smoothly before we tackle new things.

We're open to all comments and welcome any feedback you might have. We appreciate every user and try to answer all questions you might have. We are a small company doing this because we love streamers and want to provide good tools to help everyone's work.

notes.title: Streamlabs OBS Support
notes.notes: We have received questions about the possibility of supporting Streamlabs OBS also. The answer is simple: yes, we will support it. The timeframe isn't decided yet since we would rather focus on getting the system working on one platform first, but we already know we can make it work without huge efforts. There are some features that might not work due to differences between OBS Studio and Streamlabs OBS, but what exactly they are we will see later.

notes.title: We're Live!
notes.notes:
We are now live on Steam! Stream Control exists in the public! We are so excited about this!

In about two weeks the product will be available for purchase due to Steam requiring a "Coming Soon" period. You can still spread the word and get all hyped up about a new era in stream control!

We will be working on the application all the time enhancing it and adding features to make sure it's ready for the premiere. Yay!
